summary: The no_valid_comparison closure holds. The published models estimate orchiectomy on HFD and a three-group trend. Neither supplies the registered HFD-versus-chow effect in sham astrocyte IP samples. All 63 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 values, and all four computed claims reproduced. The corrected proposal records the exact count-matrix checksum match, identifies a mislabeled BioC error response, and clarifies ten swapped worksheet descriptions and the ordinal significance test. It passed the proposal validator.
openIssues: The paper leaves unclear whether its unshown sham diet test covered the nine named IP genes. The fitted model, tested genes, coefficients and gene-level statistics remain unavailable, leaving zero usable effect pairs for author concordance. [Figure 3 and accompanying Results](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10202485/#F0003)
